_comment: Phase-0 study-site manifest. Each Point is a box CENTER; the box is center.buffer(half_km). Coordinates are UNVERIFIED starting guesses in the named regions — open each in high-resolution imagery, confirm the described feature exists, set verified=true, and record the reference-imagery date. Never report results from a site whose 'verified' is false.

_schema.rationale: why this site is in the set
_schema.ref_imagery_date: date of the high-res image used to confirm the feature

properties.expected_feature: wide braided off-road corridor with multiple parallel ruts
properties.rationale: Braided corridors are the strongest Sentinel-2-resolvable target and the project's distinctive contribution.

properties.expected_feature: track showing progressive vegetation recovery vs older imagery
properties.rationale: Tests the 'recovery' end of the signal; recovery must be persistent, not a wet-year artifact.

properties.expected_feature: corridor over sparse gobi where NDVI is weak and bare-soil carries the signal
properties.rationale: Checks that the composite survives where vegetation contrast is minimal.

properties.expected_feature: mixed corridors; NOT inspected during development
properties.rationale: Reserved for the final held-out evaluation so generalization is not measured on tuning data.

properties.expected_feature: agriculture / riverbed / settlement expansion producing non-road land-use change
properties.rationale: Genuine land-cover change that must NOT be labelled as road disturbance; used to measure false positives by land type.

properties.expected_feature: open terrain with no informal roads
properties.rationale: The Phase-1 gate: the composite disturbance signal must be quantitatively WEAKER here than at development sites, or the signal is not real.
